name: text-me-secretly-client

scripts.build:vendor: npm run build:noise && npm run build:mnemonic
scripts.build:noise: esbuild build/noise-entry.mjs --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --legal-comments=none --alias:sodium-universal=./build/sodium-adapter.mjs --banner:js="/* GENERATED by 'npm run build:noise' from build/noise-entry.mjs — do not edit. Bundles noise-handshake (Noise_XX_25519_ChaChaPoly_BLAKE2b) on audited libsodium WASM (libsodium-wrappers). */" --outfile=www/js/vendor/noise-xx.js
scripts.build:mnemonic: esbuild build/mnemonic-entry.mjs --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --legal-comments=none --banner:js="/* GENERATED by 'npm run build:mnemonic' from build/mnemonic-entry.mjs — do not edit. Bundles @scure/bip39 (BIP39 mnemonics) + @noble/hashes. */" --outfile=www/js/vendor/mnemonic.js
